fields.name: Phalanx Fire
fields.description: When attacking an enemy Zoid with a ranged weapon, gain advantage on the attack roll if an ally has dealt damage to that enemy Zoid this round.

fields.name: Scrappy
fields.description: If there are no ally Zoids within 60m of you, while there are two or more enemy Zoids within 60m of you, gain advantage on all attack rolls you make.

fields.name: Mobile
fields.description: When you use your action to dash, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for the rest of the round.

fields.name: Overtuned
fields.description: Your non-weapon Zoid Equipment lasts for twice the number of rounds.

fields.name: Pit Stop
fields.description: It only takes you half as many rounds to complete a CAS swap during combat.

fields.name: Deadshot
fields.description: If you do not move on your turn, you gain a +10 to ranged attacks.

fields.name: Demolitionist
fields.description: While this feat is selected, venting a weapon removes 2 heat instead of 1 (minimum 0). Only the selected weapon is affected.
